newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to up 0.05.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to up 0.05.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged to 0.05 cent firmer Thursday, with prices seen following through on recent gains, trading sources said.

Wednesday, fund buying lifted CSCE most active July to a new contract high of 11.37 cents a lb before it closed at 11.24 cents, up 0.12. May settled up 0.26 cent at 11.53 cents while the outer contracts finished 0.08 to 0.10 cent higher.

Some traders said additional gains may be in store despite Wednesday's close sharply off the highs. Others said a dearth of fundamental news coupled with an overbought technical situation could limit the rally.
Resistance in July was pegged at 11.50 cents while support was seen at 11.20 cents.
The last trading day for the May contract is April 30.

LIFFE white sugar futures were firmer in brisk volume Thursday, on the heels of gains in New York. At 0845 EST/1345 GMT, August had pierced resistance at $315 to $317.50, up $3.10. The next overhead target was pegged at $318.
The back months stood $2.00 to $0.60 higher.
((-- S Rostler New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
